payload.summary: Ten curated WA services remain unwritten after the sexual assault, family violence, postvention and youth batches
payload.detail: The 2026-09-14 Services handover package holds 88 curated records. Reconciled against the repository on 2026-09-16: 15 already existed as canonical records, 22 are genuinely new, and the remaining 50 are updates to records already held. Twelve of the 22 are now written on branch claude/relaxed-lamport-nkowqs. The ten still to write are Ruah Engagement Hub, the Mental Health Commission My Services online directory, Links Court Program, Legal Yarn, PCH Eating Disorders Service, PCH Gender Diversity Service, Bunbury Regional Hospital Mental Health Observation Area, the KEMH Mother Baby Unit (which is a split of the existing conflated S115 record), plus Passages Perth, Passages Peel and Youth Focus, which are blocked on the publisher-registration decision. Two need adjudication before writing: PCH Gender Diversity Service against the existing Gender Pathways Service under NMHS YouthLink, and Ruah Mental Health Law Centre against the existing Ruah specialist legal services entry, which is probably a rename rather than a new record. NEXT: write the unblocked records in one batch so a single bootstrap refresh covers every addition rather than one per batch. The package's own crosswalk file is unusable for this: it never read the repository, so it marks all 88 as do-not-auto-insert, and its first record is corrupted, carrying the entire guide text in its name field.
